item.title: [IGNITE-2078] Need to clean cache after query in CacheQueryExample

>>> Average salary for 'ApacheIgnite' employees:

Alex, can you please look at this?

Btw, I have fixed id generation in example to provide consistent results.
This should be fixed in ignite-1.5 by now.

I've re-test it. We have again duplicated entries:

>>> Following people have 'Master Degree' in their resumes:
